method.claim_boundary: All results are certified local solutions. This control isolates representation resolution more strongly; it does not prove either formulation globally optimal.
method.comparison: OCP objective and production continuous hybrid replay on the OCP-discovered geometry are reported separately.
method.ocp: Fresh cold-start CasADi/IPOPT simultaneous geometry+speed solves at 24/48/96 intervals from the canonical Benchmark 8 campaign.
method.structured_refinement: Exact multilevel prolongation/resegmentation 11 -> 22 -> 44 -> 99, with every new geometry DOF free inside deterministic local trust transactions. The previously certified trajectory is retained as incumbent; faster near-feasible candidates are projected and independently re-certified.

purpose: Post-campaign fairness control for Benchmark 8. Re-optimize exactly prolonged structured trajectories before comparing with the fresh simultaneous OCP meshes.
release_interpretation: After multilevel structured reoptimization, the 99-segment structured control reaches 1.153401215 s. The 96-interval OCP objective is 1.3897% lower, and production hybrid replay on the OCP geometry is 1.9184% lower. The remaining gap is therefore better interpreted as local-basin/formulation behavior than insufficient clothoid resolution.
